name: L24_proof_point_0p2
description: The 0.2 % offset proof point: where the line parallel to the elastic line, offset by 0.002 strain, meets the curve.
derivation: Solve sigma_curve(eps) = E*(eps - 0.002). On the plateau sigma = 250, so eps = 0.002 + 250/200000 = 0.00325. The point lies on the plateau (0.0016 <= 0.00325 <= 0.015), so the 0.2 % proof strength equals the lower yield, 250 MPa. eps_p there = 0.00325 - 0.00125 = 0.002 = the offset.
